eps.ov: Shu enters his hideout for a quiet lunch only to find Inori, his #1 musical crush, bleeding on the floor. After he fails to stop her pursuers from hurting her more, his one shot at self-respect is to deliver a strange vial she stole to her terrorist pals.
eps.oa: يدخل «شو» مخبأه ليتناول غداءه في هدوء، فيجد «إينوري»، مغنيته المفضلة، تنزف على الأرض. وبعد أن يعجز عن منع مطارديها من إيذائها أكثر، تكون فرصته الوحيدة في استعادة احترامه لنفسه أن يوصل قارورة غريبة سرقتها إلى رفاقها الإرهابيين.

eps.ov: Now that Shu has the king’s power, he doesn’t get to sit on the sidelines anymore. Gai thrusts him straight into the thick of a battle between Funeral Parlor and the Anti Bodies--and the lives of over 100 hostages are on the line.
eps.oa: صارت لـ«شو» «قوة الملوك»، فلم يعد يقدر على الوقوف متفرجاً. فيلقي به «غاي» في قلب معركة بين «دار الجنائز» و«الأجسام المضادة»، وحياة أكثر من مئة رهينة على المحك.

eps.ov: Inori’s everywhere Shu goes for some reason, and it’s starting to fry his brain. But there’s no time to worry about it, because it turns out one of Shu’s classmates witnessed their terrorist action in Roppongi, and Gai’s put him in charge of the problem.
eps.oa: يجد «شو» «إينوري» حيثما ذهب لسبب ما، فيكاد يجن من ذلك. لكن لا وقت للقلق، فقد تبين أن أحد زملائه في الصف شهد عملهما الإرهابي في «روبونغي»، و«غاي» كلّفه بحل هذه المشكلة.

eps.ov: Shu learns confusing things about Funeral Parlor’s agenda in GHQ custody, and it doesn’t help that Gai refuses to answer any questions--or that he breaks into GHQ to rescue not Shu, but a known murderer. Without any straight answers, who can Shu trust?
eps.oa: يعرف «شو»، وهو محتجز لدى GHQ، أموراً محيرة عن غايات «دار الجنائز». ولا يزيد الأمر إلا سوءاً أن «غاي» يرفض الإجابة عن أي سؤال، وأنه يقتحم GHQ لينقذ، لا شو، بل قاتلاً معروفاً. فبلا أجوبة صريحة، بمن يثق شو؟

eps.ov: Gai's come up with a new mission, but before Shu can officially join the team, he has to show that he measures up by winning a mock battle against Ayase's Endlave. Time for basic training! But can Shu concentrate on combat after Inori turns him down?
eps.oa: دبّر «غاي» مهمة جديدة، لكن قبل أن ينضم «شو» إلى الفريق رسمياً عليه أن يثبت جدارته بالفوز في معركة تدريبية أمام «إندلايف» الذي تقوده «أياسي». حان وقت التدريب الأساسي! لكن أيقدر شو على التركيز في القتال بعد أن ترفضه «إينوري»؟

eps.ov: A change in circumstances forces Funeral Parlor to carry out their attack against the Leucocyte with drastically reduced manpower, and that's BEFORE Shu pulls out of the mission. Still, learning a few new things about Gai just might change his mind.
eps.oa: يجبر تغير الظروف «دار الجنائز» على تنفيذ هجومها على «ليوكوسايت» بقوة بشرية أقل كثيراً، وذلك قبل أن ينسحب «شو» من المهمة. ومع ذلك قد يغيّر رأيه ما يعرفه من أمور جديدة عن «غاي».

eps.ov: Shu's mother finally comes home, only to find her son living with a girl and an underwear-transporting robot. Elsewhere, a key strategic asset for Funeral Parlor is being targeted by a missile-happy American who's just joined GHQ.

Gai sends Shu on a mission to Oshima, where he hopes to find "the rock that started it all." Shu's whole school club gets a free vacation as his cover, but using other people for his own ends still doesn't sit well with him.

Yahiro reappears with Jun, who's in Stage V Apocalypse disease and can no longer battle the cancer. With Gai out of town, Shu's left to make a command decision. But he AND the enemy are about to learn the virus doesn't work the way they think it does...
Shu's having horrible flashbacks, both to images of his battle with Jun and to other, even more upsetting images that soon have him quitting Funeral Parlor and alienating the people in his life.
GHQ is awash in blood, chaos and song. As the Cancer sweeps over Tokyo, Shu faces the truth about friendship and the consequences of inaction.
Inori's been kidnapped by forces intent on performing a secret ceremony, and the only way for Shu to get her back is to remember what really happened on December 24th, 2029.
Two weeks after the sealing of Mana, Shu and his friends are now cut off from their families and from all of society as GHQ completely blockades off the heart of the city.

Rumors are flying about what's happening to people in the quarantine zone, and Arisa is losing control over the frenzied student body. To make matters worse, someone's let it slip that turning in members of Funeral Parlor might be their ticket to freedom.
Shu is conflicted about the Void ranking system, the student body is creaking under the tension, and vaccine stores are running low. At this rate, something--or someone--is going to snap.

Welcome to Tokyo: a ravaged world under merciless totalitarian rule. More and more of Shu's old friends are seeing a side of him they never imagined possible... and Shu's about to see a new side of the Voids, too.
Discontent within the ranks of the school is reaching fever pitch as the Exodus approaches.

Gai is back, but he doesn't seem like the man he was before. The Funeral Parlor regulars are in shock, Shu and Inori are in hiding, and Arisa's not having much luck winning friends on any side of this fight.

Things have gone too far, and as a mother, it's up to Haruka to do something about it. But fortunately or unfortunately, no one in her life seems willing to let her--and she's not the only one who's made a decision.
Ten years ago on Christmas Eve, Mana, Shu, and Gai had a fateful encounter in a church. That’s the story we already know. The story we don’t know: where were their parents?

As Funeral Parlor and the U.N. troops converge on Ward 24--for drastically different reasons--Inori hovers on the edge of becoming Mana. Meanwhile, the mysterious boy who first took her finally reveals his plans for Shu and Gai.
The Fourth Apocalypse is upon us.
